'''Ted Woodward''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 7th at [[December 1999 Austin tournament]] on 11 December 1999, according to Brian Guthrie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d142">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-11-austin-tx-12-11-99-ecc-discussiond142/ austin-tx-12-11-99-ecc-discussion], DeckTech (Brian "Red 81" Guthrie, 11 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-11-austin-tx-12-11-99-ecc-discussiond142/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
